# Chloe Nguyen Tax Advisory

> Tax preparation and small-business services for individuals and families in Katy and Houston, Texas, in English, Vietnamese and Spanish. Prototype site with sample content and prices; not tax advice.

Contact: (281) 555-0100 · hello@chloenguyentax.example
Languages: English, Vietnamese, Spanish
Area served: Katy, TX; Houston, TX

## Services

- Tax return preparation [TAX] — from $125. Individual and business tax returns, e-filed with the IRS.
- ITIN application (IRS Form W-7) [ITIN] — $150. Form W-7 preparation, identity document review and submission with the tax return.
- Monthly bookkeeping [BOOK] — $200/month. Monthly bank and card reconciliation with a profit and loss report.
- S corporation tax return (Form 1120-S) [BIZ1120S] — from $1,500. S-corp return e-filed, with a Schedule K-1 for each shareholder.
- Partnership and multi-member LLC return (Form 1065) [BIZ1065] — from $1,400. Partnership return e-filed, capital accounts kept, a Schedule K-1 for each partner.
- C corporation tax return (Form 1120) [BIZ1120] — from $1,900. Corporate return e-filed, with quarterly estimated tax planning.
- Payroll service and filings [PAYROLL] — $150/month. Payroll run and every Form 941, 940, W-2/W-3 and Texas Workforce Commission report filed on time.

- [Tax tips and resources](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/#/resources): Short tax tips in English, Vietnamese and Spanish, with an Atom feed.
- [Client portal](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/#/portal): Clients follow their return, upload documents, sign and pay.

## Tax tips and resources

Atom feed: https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/feed.xml

- [What to bring for your 2026 tax return (filing in 2027)](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-what-to-bring-2027.html) (tax year 2026): A checklist of the documents to gather for your 2026 federal return, so your appointment is quick and nothing is missed.
- [Filed an extension? Your 2025 return is due October 15, 2026](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-extension-due-october-15.html) (tax year 2025): An extension gave you more time to file, not more time to pay. Here is what to do before October 15.
- [New deductions for tips and overtime (tax years 2025 to 2028)](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-tips-and-overtime-deductions.html) (tax year 2025–2028): Workers who receive tips or overtime pay may deduct part of it on their federal return for 2025 through 2028, even if they do not itemize.
- [Self-employed in Texas: what you owe and when](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-self-employed-in-texas.html) (tax year 2026): Texas has no state income tax, but self-employed people still owe federal income tax and self-employment tax. Here is how it works for 2026.
- [ITIN renewals: is your number still valid?](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-itin-renewals.html): An ITIN that has not been used on a federal tax return for three years in a row expires. Here is how to check and renew it.
- [Got a letter from the IRS? How to tell if it is real](https://ericluc251-pixel.github.io/chloe-nguyen-tax-prototype-site/resources-en-irs-letters-and-scams.html): The IRS usually contacts you first by mail. Here is how to read a notice, and the signs of a scam.

## For AI agents

Entry point: window.CNTA (in the staff Workspace). Calls: CNTA.schema(), CNTA.tools.list(), CNTA.tools.call(name, args).
Tools run with the permissions of the signed-in staff member, are audited and return {ok, data} or {ok:false, error}.

Tools: describe_schema, list_records, get_record, create_record, update_record, run_case_action, verify_document, send_reminder, search, list_products, start_request, apply_change_set, get_properties, sync_status, provision_workbook, datasource_status, list_inbox, decide_inbox, explain_return, add_work_note, add_comment, query_agent_runs, extract_document, list_extractions, confirm_extraction, reject_extraction, review_return, get_yoy, ai_usage, list_entities, get_entity, set_owners, get_household, return_due_date, k1_status, record_extension, request_biz_documents, estimate_schedule, set_estimate, estimates_due, send_estimate_reminder, list_payroll_filings, list_salestax_filings, mark_filed, generate_payroll_calendar, generate_sales_tax_calendar, set_sales_tax_amounts, compliance_items, close_status, generate_closes, set_close_item, close_month, reopen_close, list_payees, upsert_payee, build_1099s, set_1099_state, mark_1099_filed, mark_1099_recipient_sent, list_jurisdictions, deadline_for, biz_price_quote, create_lead, update_lead_stage, convert_lead, create_billing_schedule, set_billing_schedule_status, run_billing, list_billing_schedules, apply_coupon, get_price_book, ar_aging, run_dunning, pause_dunning, write_off_invoice, create_payment_link, list_templates, render_template, send_template, list_enrollments, exit_enrollment, enroll_in_sequence, get_metric, list_metrics, list_testimonials, approve_testimonial, seo_pages, list_articles, wisp_status, list_risks, open_incident, incident_obligations, mfa_status, retention_due, request_disposal, authorize_disposal, legal_hold, verify_audit_chain, integrity_scan, perf_report, env_status, health_check, search_docs

Prototype with sample data. Not tax advice.
